finalText:
Added the 4.2.0 section to CHANGELOG.md. Flagging two things for you to sanity-check before publishing:

- **Breaking**: `fix(auth): return 401 for an expired token instead of 403` (commit `1d2bd55`) — this will break any client branching on 403 for expired tokens, so it's called out up top rather than buried in Fixed.
- The "drop the duplicate header" and "keep the trace id across the retry" fixes each landed 3 times across different releases/modules (core, http, billing / api ×3) — could mean a regression kept coming back. Worth a quick look at whether it's actually fixed now before you ship.

Everything else (dependency bumps, refactors, perf tweaks, CI/test/doc churn) I left out as not user-visible.
